evidence.quote: Marcus Bell, 52, a former commercial banker at Harborview Capital, was sentenced Friday to 30 months in federal prison after pleading guilty to submitting false income information in support of a series of business-loan applications.
At the hearing, the judge ordered Bell to pay $1.1 million in restitution and said the offense had damaged trust in the bank's lending process.
Harborview Capital said Bell left the bank after the conduct was discovered and that it has since strengthened its document-review procedures.
